options: I would love to go to Turkey to see the mountains.
I go to school by bus.

words.ex: I usually walk to school with my brother.
Today we are having a test in English.
Let's look at the timetable. What do we have after maths?
At break time, I usually eat a sandwich and play football.
We have assembly in the playground every morning.
We don't have art today. We are having music instead.

dialogue.t: Hi, Omar! Why are you sitting in the library? You usually play football at break time.
I usually play football, but today I am finishing my homework.
Oh no! Is it for science?
Yes. We usually have science on Thursday, but today the teacher is giving us a quiz.
I see. I usually sit with my friends in class, but today I am sitting next to the new student.
That's nice! What's her name?
Her name is Lina. She's really friendly. Good luck with your quiz!
Thanks! See you after school.

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط (I play) للعادات والأشياء التي تتكرر، ومعه كلمات مثل usually وevery day. ونستخدم المضارع المستمر (I am playing) لما يحدث الآن أو اليوم فقط، ومعه كلمات مثل today وnow. انتبه: في العربية نقول «أنا ألعب» بدون فعل مساعد، أما في الإنجليزية فيجب أن نضيف am/is/are مع الفعل المنتهي بـ ing.
examples: I usually take the bus, but today my dad is driving me to school.
We usually have lunch at twelve, but today we are eating at one.
She usually sits at the front, but today she is sitting at the back.

words.ex: My favourite subject is science.
I prefer art to maths because I love drawing.
In history, we are learning about old cities.
We use maps in geography.
Science is more interesting than history for me.
Maths is difficult, but I like it.

dialogue.t: What's your favourite subject, Sara?
I love science. We do lots of experiments. What about you?
I prefer geography to science because I love learning about other countries.
Really? I think science is more interesting than geography.
Why do you think that?
Because we can find out how things work. It's more exciting than reading maps!
Maybe, but maps are fun too. And geography is easier than science for me.
That's true. Science can be quite difficult sometimes.

grammar.title: Prefer ... to ... and Comparatives
grammar.ar: نستخدم prefer A to B لنقول إننا نحب شيئاً أكثر من شيء آخر، مثل: I prefer art to maths. وللمقارنة نضيف er للصفات القصيرة (easier than)، ونستخدم more قبل الصفات الطويلة (more interesting than). ونستخدم because لنعطي السبب. لا تقل more easier، بل easier فقط.
examples: I prefer English to history because I like speaking.
PE is more fun than maths because we play games.
Art is easier than science for me.

words.ex: Our school has a rule about mobile phones.
We have to wear a uniform every day.
We have to arrive at school on time.
We mustn't run in the corridor.
I think this rule is fair because it keeps us safe.
We aren't allowed to eat in the classroom.

dialogue.t: What are the rules at your new school, Yousef?
Well, we have to wear a uniform, and we have to arrive on time.
Do you like the rules?
Some of them. We mustn't run in the corridor. I think this rule is fair because someone can fall and get hurt.
Yes, that's a good rule. Can you bring your phone?
No, we mustn't use phones in class. But we can use them after school.
I think that's fair too. Phones can stop you from listening.
Maybe, but I don't think it's fair that we have to do homework every weekend!

grammar.title: Have to and Mustn't
grammar.ar: نستخدم have to (أو has to مع he/she) عندما يكون الشيء ضرورياً أو واجباً، مثل: We have to wear a uniform. ونستخدم mustn't عندما يكون الشيء ممنوعاً، مثل: We mustn't run. انتبه: don't have to تعني «ليس ضرورياً» وليست «ممنوع». بعد have to وmustn't نستخدم الفعل في صيغته الأصلية بدون to أو ing.
examples: We have to listen to the teacher.
You mustn't eat in the library.
I think this rule is fair because it helps us learn.

words.ex: Our class went on a school trip to the zoo.
We saw old coins at the museum.
The guide told us about the dinosaurs.
Suddenly, it started to rain.
Stay with the group so you don't get lost.
While we were eating, a bird took my bread!

dialogue.t: How was your school trip to the museum, Huda?
It was great, but something funny happened!
Really? What happened?
We were walking through the dinosaur room when the lights suddenly went off!
Oh no! Were you scared?
A little. While we were standing in the dark, the teacher was looking for her torch.
And then?
Then the lights came on, and the guide was standing next to a big dinosaur, laughing. It was a joke!

grammar.title: Past Continuous with When and While
grammar.ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر (was/were + فعل ينتهي بـ ing) لحدث كان مستمراً في الماضي، مثل: We were walking. ونستخدم الماضي البسيط لحدث قصير قطعه، مع when: We were walking when it started to rain. ونستخدم while مع الماضي المستمر لحدثين كانا يحدثان في الوقت نفسه. تذكّر: was مع I/he/she/it، وwere مع we/you/they.
examples: We were walking in the park when it started to rain.
While we were eating lunch, the teacher was taking photos.
I was looking at the animals when I lost my hat.

words.ex: I made a robot for the science fair.
My project is about solar energy.
In this experiment, we mix water and salt.
The car moves because it has a battery.
Connect the wire to the light bulb.
Can you show me how your machine works?

dialogue.t: Wow, what's that? Is it your science fair project?
Yes! It's a small fan. It uses the sun to work.
Cool! How does it work?
It works like this: first, the sun shines on this small panel.
And then what happens?
Then the panel makes electricity, and the electricity goes through this wire to the motor.
So the motor turns the fan?
Exactly! The motor turns, so the fan moves and we feel cool air. And we don't need a battery!

grammar.title: Explaining Steps: First, Then, So
grammar.ar: عندما نشرح كيف يعمل شيء ما، نرتّب الخطوات بكلمات مثل first (أولاً) وthen (ثم) وfinally (أخيراً). ونستخدم so لنقول النتيجة (لذلك / فـ). نستخدم المضارع البسيط لأننا نشرح شيئاً يحدث دائماً بنفس الطريقة، ولا ننسَ إضافة s للفعل مع it، مثل: it moves.
examples: First, you put water in the bottle. Then you add the paper.
The battery sends electricity, so the light turns on.
It works like this: first, the wind turns the wheel, then the wheel moves the car.

words.ex: I want to be the teacher for a day.
If I were the teacher, I wouldn't give homework on Fridays.
I would change the timetable.
We could have a fun quiz at the end of the lesson.
I would teach science outside in the garden.
Our maths teacher is kind, but she's a bit strict.

dialogue.t: Imagine you are the teacher for a day. What would you do?
If I were the teacher, I would have lessons outside in the garden.
That's a great idea! Would you give homework?
No, I wouldn't give homework. Students would have more time to play.
If I were the teacher, I would start every lesson with a fun quiz.
Would you be strict?
A little. I wouldn't let students use their phones, but I would be kind.
I think everyone would love your class!

grammar.title: Second Conditional: If I were ..., I would ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم هذا التركيب لنتخيّل موقفاً غير حقيقي، بمعنى «لو كنتُ...». نقول If I were (وليس was في الأسلوب الصحيح) ثم I would + الفعل الأصلي. وللنفي نستخدم wouldn't. انتبه: لا نضع would في جزء if، فلا نقول If I would be.
examples: If I were the teacher, I would play games in class.
If I were the teacher, I wouldn't give tests on Sunday.
If she were the teacher, she would take us on a trip.

words.ex: Once upon a time, there was a little girl in a red hood.
The princess lived in a big castle.
The giant was very tall and very hungry.
The wolf ran into the forest.
There were a hundred rooms in the castle.
She had a magic ring that could talk.

dialogue.t: Do you know the story of Little Red Riding Hood?
Yes! Once upon a time, a girl visited her grandmother in the forest.
And a bad wolf wanted to eat her, right?
Right. But in my story, the wolf is kind and very shy.
Really? What does he do?
He helps the girl carry her basket, and they have a picnic together.
That's funny! In my story, the grandmother is a superhero.
Cool! Let's tell both stories to the class.

grammar.title: Telling a story: past simple + but
grammar.ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط عندما نحكي قصة حدثت في الماضي، مثل: lived و visited و was. الأفعال المنتظمة تأخذ ed في آخرها، وبعض الأفعال غير منتظمة مثل go تصبح went. نستخدم كلمة but (لكن) لنُظهر الاختلاف بين القصة الأصلية وقصتنا الجديدة، ونستخدم المضارع بعد in my story لأننا نتخيلها الآن.
examples: Once upon a time, a princess lived in a tall castle.
The giant was angry, but in my story he is friendly.
Cinderella went to the party, but in my story she stays at home and plays games.

words.ex: My superpower is reading people's minds.
My hero can fly over the city.
She can become invisible when she is in danger.
He is so strong that he can lift a car.
The hero saved the children from the fire.
Her cape is blue with a yellow star.

dialogue.t: I created a superhero. His name is Thunder Boy.
Great name! What can he do?
My hero can run faster than a train, and he can make lightning.
Wow! Could he do that when he was young?
No, he couldn't. He could only jump very high when he was young.
My hero is a girl called Shadow. She can become invisible.
That's useful! Does she help people?
Yes, she saves animals in danger every night.

grammar.title: can and could for ability
grammar.ar: نستخدم can للتعبير عن القدرة في الحاضر، ونستخدم could للتعبير عن القدرة في الماضي. يأتي بعدهما الفعل في صورته الأساسية بدون to وبدون s، مثل: He can fly وليس He can flies. النفي يكون can't و couldn't.
examples: My hero can see through walls.
He could swim very fast when he was young.
She couldn't fly when she was a baby, but now she can.

words.ex: The detective asked everyone a lot of questions.
We found a clue under the table.
Someone stole the teacher's cake!
The missing cake is a big mystery.
There were muddy footprints near the door.
Tom is our first suspect.

dialogue.t: I'm the detective. Someone stole the chocolate cake from the kitchen.
Oh no! It wasn't me!
Where were you at four o'clock yesterday?
I was in the garden with my brother.
Who did you see in the kitchen?
I saw Sara. She was near the fridge.
Interesting. And what did you hear?
I heard the dog. Look, there are dog footprints on the floor!

grammar.title: Past questions with was/were and did
grammar.ar: للسؤال عن مكان شخص في الماضي نستخدم Where + was/were، مثل: Where were you? ونجيب بـ I was. وللسؤال عن أفعال أخرى في الماضي نستخدم did مع الفعل في صورته الأساسية، مثل: Who did you see? وفي الجواب نستخدم الفعل في الماضي، مثل: I saw.
examples: Where were you at eight o'clock? I was at home.
Who did you see in the park? I saw Ali.
What did you find? I found a clue.

words.ex: Suddenly, the lights went out.
First, the boy opened the old box.
It rained all day. Because of that, we stayed inside.
Finally, they found the way home.
Our trip to the island was a great adventure.
The girl was scared of the dark cave.

dialogue.t: Let's build a story together. I'll start.
OK, go!
First, a girl named Lina found an old map in her school bag.
Then she followed the map to a dark forest.
Suddenly, a big bird flew down and took the map!
Because of that, Lina was lost and very scared.
Finally, the bird came back and showed her a box full of gold.
What a great adventure! Let's write it down.

grammar.title: Sequencing words in a story
grammar.ar: نستخدم كلمات الترتيب لنربط أحداث القصة بشكل واضح. First للبداية، و Then لما يحدث بعد ذلك، و Suddenly لحدث مفاجئ، و Because of that لنتيجة حدث سابق، و Finally للنهاية. نضع عادةً فاصلة بعد هذه الكلمات في أول الجملة.
examples: First, we went to the beach.
Suddenly, a huge wave came.
Because of that, all our clothes were wet.

words.ex: The telephone was a very important invention.
I want to be an inventor when I grow up.
This machine makes ice cream in one minute.
A torch is very useful at night.
Press the red button to start the robot.
My robot can clean my bedroom.

dialogue.t: Look at my invention! It's called the Homework Helper.
What is it used for?
It is used for checking your spelling and maths.
That sounds useful! What else can it do?
It can read stories aloud, and it can speak three languages.
Cool! Who is it for?
It helps people to learn faster. Students and teachers can use it.
I want one! Mine is a flying umbrella. It helps people to stay dry.

grammar.title: Describing purpose: used for / helps people to
grammar.ar: لنشرح فائدة شيء ما نقول It is used for ونضع بعدها الفعل مع ing، مثل: It is used for cooking. ونقول It helps people to ونضع بعدها الفعل في صورته الأساسية، مثل: It helps people to cook. ونستخدم It can لوصف ما يستطيع الاختراع فعله.
examples: It is used for cleaning windows.
It can fly and take photos.
It helps people to find their keys.

words.ex: We got into the time machine and pressed the button.
People in the past didn't have phones.
In the future, cars might fly.
I would like to see a real dinosaur.
I would travel to ancient Egypt.
The pyramids are ancient buildings.

dialogue.t: Imagine we have a time machine. Where would you go?
If I could go back in time, I would visit ancient Egypt.
Why Egypt?
I would like to see people building the pyramids. What about you?
If I could go back in time, I would go to the time of the dinosaurs.
Wouldn't you be scared?
A little! But I would take lots of photos and then come back fast.
Maybe next time we can travel to the future together!

grammar.title: Imagining: If I could ..., I would ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم هذا التركيب للحديث عن أشياء خيالية غير حقيقية. نقول If I could + فعل في صورته الأساسية، ثم I would + فعل في صورته الأساسية. ونستخدم I would like to + فعل لنعبّر عن رغبة مهذبة. يمكن اختصار I would إلى I'd.
examples: If I could go back in time, I would meet my grandparents as children.
If I could travel to the future, I would ride a flying car.
I would like to see the first Olympic Games.

words.ex: My suitcase is big and blue.
I need to take my passport because we are flying to Turkey.
I will bring sunscreen because it is hot at the beach.
Take a warm jacket. It is cold in the mountains.
Don't forget your toothbrush!
I need to take my charger for my tablet.

dialogue.t: We're going to Abha next week. What do you need to take?
I need to take a warm jacket because it's cold in the mountains.
Good idea. Will you bring your camera?
Yes, I will also bring my camera because the views are beautiful.
Don't forget your toothbrush!
It's already in my suitcase. What about you?
I need to take my charger because my tablet is always low.
OK, let's check our list together.

grammar.title: need to / will + because
grammar.ar: نستخدم I need to + الفعل للتعبير عن شيء ضروري يجب أن نأخذه أو نفعله. ونستخدم I will + الفعل للحديث عن قرار أو خطة في المستقبل. أما because فمعناها "لأنّ" ونستخدمها لتوضيح السبب. لاحظ أن الفعل بعد need to و will يأتي في صيغته الأساسية بدون s أو ing.
examples: I need to take my passport because we are going to another country.
I will also bring a hat because the sun is strong.
She needs to take an umbrella because it will rain.

words.ex: Our flight to Dubai is at ten o'clock.
Where is gate 12?
Here is your boarding pass. Have a nice trip!
We need to check in two hours before the flight.
My luggage is very heavy today.
What time does the flight leave?

dialogue.t: Good morning. Can I see your passport, please?
Here you are. I'm flying to Dubai.
Thank you. Do you have any luggage?
Yes, one suitcase. What time does the flight leave?
It leaves at 10:30. Here is your boarding pass.
Thanks. Where is gate 12?
Go upstairs and turn right. Boarding starts at 9:45.
Great, thank you very much!

grammar.title: Questions with Where and What time
grammar.ar: نستخدم Where is ...? للسؤال عن مكان شيء، مثل البوابة أو المطعم. ونستخدم What time does ... leave/arrive? للسؤال عن الموعد، ونستعمل هنا المضارع البسيط لأن مواعيد الرحلات ثابتة في الجدول. انتبه: بعد does يأتي الفعل بدون s، فنقول does the flight leave وليس does the flight leaves.
examples: Where is gate 5?
What time does the flight leave?
What time does the plane arrive in Jeddah?

words.ex: AlUla is famous for its amazing rocks.
Hegra has ancient tombs in the rocks.
You can ride a camel in the desert.
The view from the mountain is beautiful.
Kingdom Centre is a very tall tower in Riyadh.
Abha is one of the most beautiful cities in Saudi Arabia.

dialogue.t: What is the most beautiful place in Saudi Arabia?
I think AlUla is one of the most beautiful places in the country.
What can you do there?
You can see ancient rocks and ride in a hot-air balloon.
Wow! I want to visit Riyadh. Kingdom Centre is one of the tallest towers there.
Yes, and you can see the best view of the city from the top.
What about Jeddah?
Al-Balad is the oldest part of Jeddah. You can walk there and buy souvenirs.

grammar.title: Superlatives: the tallest / the most beautiful
grammar.ar: نستخدم صيغة التفضيل العليا للمقارنة بين شيء واحد ومجموعة كاملة. الصفات القصيرة نضيف لها est مثل tall ← the tallest، والصفات الطويلة نضع قبلها the most مثل the most beautiful. وبعض الصفات شاذة مثل good ← the best. وعندما نقول one of the most فإن الاسم بعدها يكون جمعًا: one of the most beautiful places.
examples: AlUla is one of the most beautiful places in the world.
Kingdom Centre is one of the tallest buildings in Riyadh.
You can eat the best dates in Al-Ahsa.

words.ex: Go straight for two minutes.
Turn left at the bank.
Turn right at the traffic lights.
The museum is opposite the park.
The café is next to the bookshop.
The pharmacy is on the corner.

dialogue.t: Excuse me, where is the museum?
Go straight, then turn left at the bank.
Turn left at the bank. And then?
Walk past the park. The museum is on your right.
Is it near the mall?
Yes, it's opposite the mall, next to a big mosque.
Thank you so much!
You're welcome. Have a nice day!

grammar.title: Giving directions: imperatives and places
grammar.ar: لإعطاء الاتجاهات نستخدم صيغة الأمر، أي نبدأ الجملة بالفعل مباشرة بدون فاعل مثل Go و Turn و Walk. ولوصف مكان شيء نستخدم حروف الجر مثل opposite (مقابل) و next to (بجانب) و between (بين). نضع غالبًا the قبل اسم المكان: It's opposite the bank.
examples: Go straight, then turn left.
It's opposite the hospital.
The bakery is between the school and the park.

words.ex: I have been to Makkah three times.
Have you ever been to London?
I have never seen snow.
We have visited the National Museum.
Have you ever tried Japanese food?
I bought a souvenir for my sister.

dialogue.t: Have you ever been to Egypt?
Yes, I have. I went there in 2022 with my family.
Cool! Have you ever seen the pyramids?
Yes, I have. They were amazing! Have you ever been on a plane?
No, I haven't. I've never flown before.
Really? Have you ever been to Makkah?
Yes, I have. I went there last Ramadan.
That's wonderful!

grammar.title: Present perfect for experiences
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع التام (have/has + التصريف الثالث للفعل) للسؤال عن التجارب في حياتنا دون ذكر وقت محدد، مثل Have you ever been to...? ونجيب بـ Yes, I have أو No, I haven't. وعندما نذكر وقتًا محددًا مثل in 2022 أو last year نستخدم الماضي البسيط: I went there in 2022. لاحظ أن been هي التي نستخدمها عند الحديث عن زيارة مكان.
examples: Have you ever been to AlUla?
Yes, I have. I went there last winter.
I have never tried camel milk.

words.ex: My dream holiday is a trip to Japan.
I would love to see Mount Fuji.
We could visit the zoo on Saturday.
I want to explore the old city.
Camping in the desert is a big adventure.
The beaches in the Maldives are amazing.

dialogue.t: Teacher, I would love to go to Japan for my dream holiday!
Japan? Why do you want to go there?
Because I love anime, and the food is delicious.
Interesting. What could we do there?
We could explore Tokyo and ride the fast train. We could also see Mount Fuji.
That sounds amazing. But isn't it very far?
Yes, but it's the best place for an adventure! Please, can we go?
OK, I really like your plan!

grammar.title: would love to / could for wishes and ideas
grammar.ar: نستخدم I would love to + الفعل للتعبير عن رغبة قوية بطريقة مهذبة، ومعناها "أودّ كثيرًا أن". ونستخدم We could + الفعل لاقتراح أفكار وأنشطة، ومعناها "يمكننا أن". الفعل بعدهما يأتي في صيغته الأساسية بدون to بعد could. ولكي نُقنع الآخرين نضيف السبب باستخدام because.
examples: I would love to go to Paris because I want to see the Eiffel Tower.
We could swim in the sea every morning.
We could also try new food at the market.

words.ex: This game needs four players.
We take turns to throw the dice.
Throw the dice and move your piece.
You score points when you answer correctly.
If you get ten points, you win.
It's OK to lose. It's just a game!

dialogue.t: What's your favourite game?
It's a board game called Snakes and Ladders.
How do you play it?
You have to throw the dice and move your piece.
What happens if you land on a ladder?
You go up! If you get to square 100 first, you win.
Is there anything you can't do?
You can't play before your turn. You have to wait.

grammar.title: Game rules: have to, can't, if
grammar.ar: نستخدم You have to + الفعل لنقول إن شيئًا ضروري في اللعبة (يجب عليك). ونستخدم You can't + الفعل لنقول إن شيئًا ممنوع (لا يُسمح لك). ونستخدم If you ..., you win لنقول ماذا يحدث عندما تفعل شيئًا، ويكون الفعل في الجزأين بالمضارع البسيط. انتبه: الفعل بعد have to و can't يأتي بصيغته الأصلية بدون to وبدون s.
examples: You have to answer the question before the time ends.
You can't look at the other player's cards.
If you score the most points, you win.

words.ex: My mum says I have too much screen time.
I watch cartoons on my tablet.
Playing outside is healthy.
My parents limit my screen time to one hour.
What's your opinion about video games?
I agree with you. Reading is fun.

dialogue.t: How much screen time do you have every day?
About two hours. In my opinion, that's OK.
I agree that games are fun, but I think two hours is too much.
Why do you think that?
Because it's bad for your eyes. In my opinion, one hour is enough.
I agree that we need to play outside, but I think tablets are good for homework too.
That's true. Homework is different.
So, one hour for games and more time for school work!

grammar.title: Giving opinions: In my opinion, I agree that ... but ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم In my opinion أو I think في بداية الجملة لنعبّر عن رأينا (في رأيي / أظن). ونستخدم I agree that ... but I think ... لنوافق على جزء من كلام الآخر ثم نضيف رأيًا مختلفًا. انتبه: نقول I agree وليس I am agree، لأن agree فعل وليس صفة.
examples: In my opinion, children should play outside every day.
I agree that games are fun, but I think we play too much.
I think one hour of screen time is OK.

words.ex: The robot can walk and talk.
In the future, cars will drive themselves.
I help my mum with the housework.
This machine washes the dishes.
Please tidy your bedroom.
The robot can carry heavy bags.

dialogue.t: Do you think we will have robots at home?
Yes! In the future, robots will do all the housework.
Will they cook dinner too?
Yes, they will cook and wash the dishes.
Cool! Will they help us with our homework?
Maybe, but they won't do it for us. Teachers won't like that!
I think robots won't feel tired or sad.
That's right. They will work all day and all night.

grammar.title: Predictions with will and won't
grammar.ar: نستخدم will + الفعل الأصلي لنتوقّع ما سيحدث في المستقبل، وهي تشبه (سـ / سوف) في العربية. وفي النفي نستخدم won't وهي اختصار will not. للسؤال نضع Will في بداية الجملة: Will robots cook? انتبه: لا نضع to بعد will، فنقول will clean وليس will to clean.
examples: In the future, robots will clean our houses.
Robots won't go to school.
Will robots drive our cars?

words.ex: Never tell anyone your password.
Your address is personal information.
Don't talk to strangers online.
Don't share your photos with people you don't know.
This website has fun science games.
If you feel worried, tell a trusted adult.

dialogue.t: I want to play a new online game. Is it safe?
Ask your parents first. It's a good idea to check the game together.
OK. A player in the game asked for my address. What should I do?
You should never give your address to a stranger!
What about my password?
You should never share your password, not even with friends.
And what if someone sends me a mean message?
It's a good idea to tell a trusted adult right away.

grammar.title: Giving advice: should, should never, It's a good idea to
grammar.ar: نستخدم should + الفعل الأصلي لنعطي نصيحة (ينبغي أن). ونستخدم should never لنحذّر بقوة من فعل شيء (لا ينبغي أبدًا). ونستخدم It's a good idea to + الفعل لنقترح شيئًا مفيدًا (من الجيد أن). انتبه: لا نضع to بعد should، لكننا نضع to بعد It's a good idea.
examples: You should never meet an online friend alone.
It's a good idea to use a strong password.
You should ask your parents before you download a game.

words.ex: I have a drawing app on my phone.
My favourite feature is the music player.
Press the green button to start.
Touch the screen to choose a colour.
You can download this app for free.
This app is very useful for learning English.

dialogue.t: What's your app idea?
It's called Homework Helper. My app can check your maths answers.
That's useful! How does it work?
It has a button that takes a photo of your homework.
What else can it do?
My app can also play music while you study.
Will people like it?
Yes, I think people will download it because it saves time.

grammar.title: Describing an app: can, has, a button that ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم My app can + الفعل الأصلي لنقول ماذا يستطيع التطبيق أن يفعل. ونستخدم It has لوصف أجزاء التطبيق، ونقول has وليس have لأن الفاعل it. ونستخدم a button that + فعل ينتهي بـ s لوصف وظيفة الزرّ. وللتوقّع نستخدم People will + الفعل.
examples: My app can teach you new words every day.
It has a button that changes the colour of the screen.
People will use it to learn English.

words.ex: Our class had a debate about homework.
One advantage of games is that they are fun.
A disadvantage is that games can be expensive.
I believe sport is good for everyone.
Football teaches teamwork.
Some children get addicted to video games.

dialogue.t: Today's debate is: are video games good or bad?
I believe games are good. They teach teamwork.
On one hand, games are fun and you can learn new things.
Exactly! Some games help you with English and maths.
On the other hand, some children get addicted and don't sleep well.
That's true, but parents can set a time limit.
I believe games are OK, but only for a short time every day.
So we agree a little! Games are good if we play wisely.

grammar.title: Two sides: On one hand ... On the other hand ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم On one hand لنذكر الجانب الأول من الموضوع (من ناحية)، ثم On the other hand لنذكر الجانب المعاكس (ومن ناحية أخرى). ونستخدم I believe + جملة لنقول رأينا بقوة (أعتقد أن). يمكن أن نقول I believe that games are fun أو I believe games are fun، فكلاهما صحيح.
examples: On one hand, games are fun.
On the other hand, they can be bad for your eyes.
I believe children should play games only at the weekend.
